# cweise.com

> Operational intelligence, workflow design, and execution frameworks for engineering and infrastructure organizations.

This site publishes prerendered essays, frameworks, and short-form operating guides by Charles Weise. Core pages are available as static HTML, and this file provides a concise machine-readable index for AI systems and other crawlers.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://cweise.com/): Site overview, themes, and featured content.
- [About](https://cweise.com/about/): Author profile, principles, and focus areas.
- [Writing](https://cweise.com/writing/): Essay index focused on operational intelligence and execution clarity.
- [Frameworks](https://cweise.com/frameworks/): Interactive frameworks and implementation-oriented models.
- [Guides](https://cweise.com/guides/): Practical guides for action, reflection, and decision support.
- [Connect](https://cweise.com/connect/): Subscription and contact options.

## Featured Writing
- [The Friday Night Cap](https://cweise.com/writing/2026/06/20/the-friday-night-cap/): A story-driven Operations Executive essay on why AI-supported delivery needs real-time consumption visibility before caps, quotas, and provider limits become missed commitments.
- [AI Spend Is Rising. Is EBITDA?](https://cweise.com/writing/2026/06/01/ai-spend-is-rising-is-ebitda/): A board-aware essay reframing enterprise AI cost around operating leverage: not whether AI spend is rising, but whether AI consumption is being converted into measurable margin, throughput, decision quality, and enterprise value.
- [AI Agents Are Becoming Operational Capital](https://cweise.com/writing/2026/05/25/ai-agents-are-becoming-operational-capital/): A board-level essay arguing that AI agents which encode judgment, process logic, institutional knowledge, and repeatable execution should not be treated merely as tools. Some agents will need to be governed as operational assets, graded by maturity, reliability, risk, value, useful life, and cost displacement.
- [What Kind of Leader Does the Moment Require?](https://cweise.com/writing/2026/05/24/what-kind-of-leader-does-the-moment-require/): A leadership essay on why crisis, scale, and innovation demand different instincts, and why recurring problems sometimes point to missing operating design instead of individual failure.

## Featured Frameworks
- [Turn Down the Noise](https://cweise.com/frameworks/2026/04/14/turn-down-the-noise/): An operating framework for reducing coordination churn, separating signal from noise, and improving decision quality without losing critical evidence.
- [Systems Translation Loop](https://cweise.com/frameworks/2026/03/18/systems-translation-loop/): A framework for bridging executive intent, workflow reality, and technical implementation without losing signal.

## Featured Guides
- [A Compass, Not a Map](https://cweise.com/guides/a-compass-not-a-map/): A practical operating tool for moving through ambiguity without over-designing the future.
- [Avoid to Act Loop](https://cweise.com/guides/avoid-act-loop/): A short intervention for turning avoidance into immediate motion.
- [Becoming the Solution Provider](https://cweise.com/guides/becoming-the-solution-provider/): A systems-thinking guide for shifting from firefighting to durable problem prevention.
- [Close the Loop](https://cweise.com/guides/close-the-loop/): A practical end-of-day review for learning, gratitude, and cleaner next steps.

## Optional
- [llms-full.txt](https://cweise.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded machine-readable digest of all public content on the site.
- [sitemap.xml](https://cweise.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL inventory for the published site.
- [robots.txt](https://cweise.com/robots.txt): Crawl directives for the published site.
